65.literal: Who're you callin' 'old man,' you son of a bitch!

66.literal: What a pain. Let's just take another road.
66.official: It's not worth the trouble. Let's take a different road.

67.literal: If you've got nothin' to do with this, butt out!!

68.literal: Huh, wha...? What on earth is happening to me...?

69.literal: Let's see... I was at a bar watching a music show, and...
69.official: I remember watching music videos at that bar...

70.literal: and then we got on the topic of which idols we liked—
70.official: Then we got to talking about which idols we liked...

71.literal: the conversation turned to that, and...
71.official: Then we got to talking about which idols we liked...

72.literal: Right, right, and then, my Shoko-chan—
72.official: Yeah, then some smartass started making fun of poor, sweet Shoko-chan, and then...

73.literal: Ugh, my head's throbbing and I just can't remember.
73.official: Rgh, my head's throbbing. I can't remember past that.

74.literal: That's enough for today—go on home.
74.official: I think you two have had enough for tonight. Go home.

75.literal: Sorry about that. My, you're such a kind young fellow...
75.official: Oof, thanks. You're awful considerate for a kid your age.

76.literal: Heh, isn't that exactly why people come flocking here?
76.official: They come thirsty for booze and women, and Kamurocho's got both in spades.

77.literal: Guys who struck it rich in this recent boom—
77.official: the newly-minted rich playboys this economy's churned out.

78.literal: a bunch who're nothing but walking greed.
78.official: They come thirsty for booze and women, and Kamurocho's got both in spades.

79.literal: Those guys crave booze and women and all that, and—
79.official: They come thirsty for booze and women

80.literal: What, so in your clumsy way you actually get it after all, huh.
80.official: When did you start waxing poetic? Not that you're wrong.

81.literal: So, changed your opinion of me now?

82.literal: Heh, what's this, you doubting what I'm telling you?

83.literal: Hmm, I'd like to believe you, but...

84.literal: Aw, don't say that. ...Here, a little pocket money for you.
84.official: Aw, don't be like that. Here, buy yourselves something nice.

85.literal: When'd you become such a big shot, Nishiki?
85.official: When did you get so popular with the ladies, Nishiki?

86.literal: Staying connected with women is what matters.
86.official: Building connections with girls is important.

87.literal: Look, the big brothers above us in the family...
87.official: The guys higher up the chain than us in the family?

88.official: One look and anybody with eyes can tell they're yakuza, and not the fun kind.

89.literal: So, when I go drinking with the big brothers,
89.official: So, if you show up with a pack of girls every time the bosses invite you drinking, they remember you.

90.literal: just bringing along a bunch of women gets me some spending money,
90.official: Half the time they give me cash on the spot.

91.literal: There's no point unless you claw your way to the top.
91.official: you've gotta claw your way up that ladder using any means possible.

92.literal: You're keeping me company all the way tonight, got it.
92.official: Hope you're ready, because I'm not stopping till morning.

93.official: (It looks like that loan shark set me up.)

94.literal: (Just what kind of scheme is going on here...)
94.official: (I don't know what his game is...)

96.literal: If you don't mind me, I'll hear you out, okay?
96.official: I can't promise much, but I'm happy to lend you an ear.

97.literal: I've got a favor to ask you, boy!
97.official: Anyway, I had a favor I wanted to ask you.

98.literal: Hey, geezer... this the young guy you meant?
98.official: Alright, gramps... Is this the kid?

100.literal: ...Don't tell me, that one million yen—
100.official: ...Wait, you don't expect ME to pay, do you?

102.literal: You'd best cough up the cash before you get hurt—for your own good, y'know?
102.official: For your own sake, I'd pay up before I got hurt.

103.literal: Don't drag me into your troublesome mess.
103.official: You're not going to drag me into your problems.

104.literal: In other words, you're not confident, are you?
104.official: Oh, so you think he'd beat you.

105.literal: ...Trying to goad me on like that won't get you anywhere.
105.official: ...Look, if you're trying to bait me, it's not going to work.

106.literal: Pay your own damn debt yourself.
106.official: It's your debt, you handle it.

107.literal: There are tons of guys like that all over the world, you know?
107.official: He's bargain-bin muscle. Dime a dozen.

109.official: I feel terrible, just terrible for all the hassle I caused.

110.literal: Two million?! Like I'd ever believe a story like that!
110.official: You wanna pay me double!? Like I'm gonna buy that!

111.official: You're drunk off your ass, old man!

113.literal: That fellow behind you does the fighting,
113.official: You have your tank back there fight us for it.

114.literal: but if we win, we won't pay the money.
114.official: We win, and we don't owe you a thing.

115.literal: Even if the three of you gang up, you haven't got a chance, you know?
115.official: All three of you could rush him at the same time and he'd snap you like twigs.

116.literal: I'm telling you up front, I've got no intention of helping.
116.official: I'll tell you right now I'm not bailing you out.

117.literal: Kamoji here is just gonna try a little, okay.
117.official: He'll be fine. Just a little workout.

118.literal: You, boy—keep your eyes on Kamoji's moves.

119.literal: An amateur shouldn't push his luck.
119.official: You shouldn't push yourself like that.

120.literal: The other guy's punches aren't landing at all, huh.
120.official: Big guy didn't land a single punch on him.

121.literal: Hey, you—the homeless guy over there!
121.official: Hey, you in the coat. Homeless dude!

122.literal: You're gonna keep going with those wimpy little punches?
122.official: You gonna try to finish the job with those weak-ass punches?

123.literal: Heh... Well, guess there's no helping it.

124.literal: I didn't have the slightest bit of motivation for this, but...
124.official: I meant it when I said I wouldn't bail you out,

125.literal: After seeing that guy's moves, though, I changed my mind...
125.official: but watching him just put me in the mood for a quick round.

127.literal: Wh... Bruno's getting beaten this one-sidedly...
127.official: What just happened? Bruno barely got a punch in!
